facts.fact: Gabonmediatime reports that the Sino-Gabonese Cooperation Hospital in Libreville launched the eGabon SIS platform on 13 July 2026, with the computerised patient record directly accessible to doctors and the cashier and record already working.
The Sino-Gabonese Cooperation Hospital went live on eGabon SIS on 13 July 2026, with laboratory and radiology to be integrated progressively.
